data.desc: Founded in 1990 and headquartered in Novato, California, Bank of Marin is a wholly owned subsidiary of Bank of Marin Bancorp (Nasdaq: BMRC). With assets of $3.9 billion, Bank of Marin is a leading business and community bank providing commercial and personal banking, specialty lending, and wealth management and trust services through a network of 27 branches and eight commercial banking offices serving Northern California.
